maison.text: We make every part of the burger: the patty, the chips, even the bun. The sauces simmer here, and so do the desserts.

privat.title: Hire Le Disque Bleu
privat.text: A birthday, a leaving do, a team or family meal: tell us the date and the number of guests and we'll come back with a proposal. We also deliver our home-made burgers and chips for your parties.

team.title: You're always welcome here
text: Le Disque Bleu is the café where they know your face. Your espresso arrives before you ask, the sunny table is kept for you, and every single review gets a personal reply.
In the kitchen, the chef prepares the dish of the day each morning from fresh produce. Monday means couscous royal: the vegetable broth is on the stove from opening time.

items.a: You don't have to, but it's safer at lunchtime, at weekends and on event nights. Book online or on +33 1 75 40 78 27; we call you back to confirm.
Yes. For more than 12 people, use the group request: we'll sort out the table, the menu and the time with you.

items.q: Can the restaurant be hired privately?
items.a: Yes, for a birthday, drinks or a company meal. Send us the date, the number of guests and your budget, and we'll reply with a proposal.

items.q: What is the dish of the day?
items.a: It changes every lunchtime and goes up on the board each morning. Call us, or check our Instagram stories. On Mondays it's couscous royal.

items.q: Do you offer takeaway and delivery?
items.a: Takeaway, yes: order online or by phone and pick your meal up. For delivery, call us and we'll tell you what's possible.

items.q: Is the terrace open all year?
items.a: It's set up on the square whenever the weather allows, sheltered under the awning. In summer we stay open until 10 pm.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Bank cards and cash. For French meal vouchers, please ask us by phone.

restaurant.h1: Restaurant in Montmorency, on place Roger Levanneur
restaurant.intro: A neighbourhood brasserie that cooks every day: a dish of the day at lunch, the classics all week, and couscous royal on Mondays.

sections.h: A dish of the day, every lunchtime
p: Each morning the chef writes a new dish on the board. In recent months it has been a veal chop with shallot sauce and home-made mash, ox tongue, beef bourguignon, mussels and chips, paella, choucroute garnie.
Monday is always couscous royal: semolina, vegetable broth, roast chicken and merguez.

sections.h: A burger whose bun we bake too
p: The home-made burger has become the most requested dish on the menu. The patty is shaped here, the bun comes out of our oven, the chips are cut and fried on site.
Alongside it, the brasserie staples: a butcher's cut steak with parsley butter, grilled andouillette, chopped steak with a fried egg, grilled salmon, escalope milanese, and pasta for every taste.

sections.h: Lunch in Montmorency, inside or on the terrace
p: Le Disque Bleu is at 8 place Roger Levanneur, in the centre of Montmorency (Val-d'Oise), a few minutes from Enghien-les-Bains, Soisy-sous-Montmorency and Deuil-la-Barre.
We serve Monday to Saturday from 7 am to 9 pm and Sundays from 7:30 am to 3 pm. Expect €10 to €20 per person. Booking is advised at lunchtime and at weekends.

bar.title: Bar and terrace in Montmorency
bar.metaTitle: Bar and terrace in Montmorency: cocktails, coffee, tabac | Le Disque Bleu
bar.metaDescription: Bar, terrace and tabac in Montmorency, place Roger Levanneur: coffee from 7 am, cocktails with or without alcohol, boards, home-made crêpes in the afternoon. Open 7 days a week.
bar.intro: Morning coffee, a drink on the terrace, an evening cocktail. And the tabac, open all day.

sections.h: A terrace on place Roger Levanneur
p: Round marble tables edged in brass, woven chairs, a red awning: the terrace of Le Disque Bleu looks onto the square and catches the sun for much of the day.
People have breakfast here, lunch here, and order a home-made crêpe from 3 pm. In summer it stays open until 10 pm.
On the list: mojito, spritz, piña colada, Fun on the Beach, Swimming Pool. Plus four alcohol-free cocktails, from the virgin mojito to the Coconut Island.
To go with them, a charcuterie board to share. Please drink responsibly.
From 7 am (7:30 am on Sundays), the counter serves coffee, cappuccino, hot chocolate and the breakfast deal: croissant or pain au chocolat, fresh orange juice and a hot drink.
Le Disque Bleu is also the tobacconist's on the square.
